{{Quote|You can't take our beskar'gam. Do you know what that means to a Mandalorian?|Jhan to Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />}}
'''Jhan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] hired by [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]] to serve as security in their [[asteroid crusher]] ''[[Ormni]]''. Along with her brother [[Joram]], they were stationed near a turbolift when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] burst into the room and took them captive. Trying to avoid capture from the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] security detail, the Jedi pair incapacitated Jhan and Joram with [[hypo]]'s filled with anesthesia and then took their [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] for disguise.<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />
